License: Mozilla Public License 2.0. Bundled packages keep their own licenses
(numpy, pandas: BSD-3-Clause; python-dateutil: Apache-2.0 / BSD; pytz: MIT; six: MIT).

pyodide.js, pyodide.asm.js   unmodified from the npm package
pyodide-core-b64.js          interpreter wasm (gzip) + standard library, base64
pyodide-sqlite3-b64.js       the sqlite3 module
pyodide-pandas-b64.js        numpy + pandas and their dependencies (loaded only by pandas lessons)

Regenerate with tools/build-pyodide-vendor.js.
